runtime_ratio_scope: Mean of each program's two repeats per arm; not total allocation JCT or equal-quality speedup.
interpretation: Co-location reduced observed optimizer steps and DEV performance. A wall-clock-controlled program can finish earlier while doing less work, so shorter execution time is not necessarily computational acceleration. Static guard scopes are not runtime branch traces and do not alone establish the number of completed epochs/folds.
estimand_boundary: The lower scores are genuine produced-output quality under allocated resources, not automatically wrong labels. A scheduler must trade additional candidate throughput against per-candidate work/quality, with final search quality as target. This is not a new method or proof of a rank reversal.
nearest_work_boundary: SchedMate already uses source/log semantics and throughput interference; HyperSched already targets best accuracy by a resource deadline. Neither quality awareness nor reading code is claimed novel.
